LAREDO, Texas — Bryan Charbel Torralba-Sanchez was arrested Tuesday evening, October 21, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged third-degree felony charge of possession of a controlled substance in penalty group 2 in an amount of less than 1 gram in a drug-free zone, according to Webb County booking records.

Torralba-Sanchez was arrested at 6:16 p.m. by U.S. Customs and Border Protection. The booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956 listed one charge and an immigration hold.

Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. No court case number was listed.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Bryan Charbel Torralba-Sanchez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
